title: The Great Hunt: Mother Ashtalon

texts.details:
Tysha's hunter? Then sit, and keep your voice down. I have been watching these raptors for a season and I am still not sure which of us is watching the other.

They are clever, $N. Not clever for a beast. Clever. In the Barrens a pack of them stole a shipment of silver from an orc town, and no one has yet explained what they wanted it for. They wear feathers. They wear beads. The trolls call the raptor the truest form of a hunter, and the trolls are not often wrong about killing.

Take eight of the striders on the plains west of here. Watch who gives the signal. Then find the one the others watch: an old female. I call her Mother Ashtalon.
texts.objectives: Kill 8 Highland Striders in the Arathi Highlands and then Mother Ashtalon, among the raptors west of Refuge Pointe. Return to Kinelory.
texts.progress: Do not look for the biggest. Look for the one the others keep glancing at.
texts.completion:
So she is down. And her pack scattered the moment she fell, did you see? That is the third lesson. With cats you hunt the animal. With raptors you hunt the one that is doing the thinking.

A hunter who has learned that can keep more than one companion, each for its own work, and know which to bring. The stable masters hold to an old custom: one who has taken the third beast of the Hunt is owed a stall. It is yours.

The fourth beast is far south, in Stranglethorn. At Nesingwary's camp, north of the river, ask for Barnil Stonepot. Go when you have forty seasons of sense, and not before.

idea: The Great Hunt, level 30 (Alliance): the raptor.
